economy.summary: Voted in 2023 for House Bill 1500, which would raise Pennsylvania's minimum wage in steps from $7.25 to $15 an hour by 2026 with cost-of-living adjustments afterward. His campaign platform says jobs at good wages must be available so young people can stay in Northeast Pennsylvania and build their families there.
economy.short: Voted to raise state minimum wage to $15 by 2026.

taxes.summary: Supported the 2023 expansion of Pennsylvania's Property Tax/Rent Rebate Program, which raised income limits and increased the maximum rebate to $1,000, calling it an overdue measure for residents on fixed incomes. His campaign platform calls for property tax solutions that relieve homeowners while maintaining education funding.
taxes.short: Supported expanded property tax rebates; seeks homeowner tax relief.

abortion.summary: Voted in 2022 against a proposed state constitutional amendment stating there is no right to abortion, and earlier voted against bills banning abortion after a Down syndrome diagnosis. He was endorsed by Planned Parenthood for the 2024 election.
abortion.short: Voted against abortion restrictions; endorsed by Planned Parenthood.

education.summary: Voted for the 2026-27 state budget and touted its additional $565 million for inadequately funded school districts.
education.short: Voted for budget adding $565 million for underfunded schools.

healthcare.summary: Says he first successfully fought for a $5 million state appropriation for neuromuscular disease research, an appropriation renewed in the 2026-27 budget he voted for.
healthcare.short: Championed $5 million state neuromuscular disease research appropriation.

energy.summary: Proposed data center restrictions that were adopted in the 2026-27 state budget, requiring operators to report energy and water usage annually, and said he hopes further bills to rein in data centers become law.
energy.short: Proposes data center limits, annual energy and water reporting.

guns.summary: Voted in 2023 for House Bill 714, which would expand background check requirements to private sales of long guns in Pennsylvania.
guns.short: Voted to expand background checks to private long-gun sales.

economy.summary: His campaign says it supports smart, environmentally sound economic growth for the district and opposes proposed mega data centers.
economy.short: Supports environmentally sound growth; opposes proposed mega data centers.

taxes.summary: His campaign says school and property taxes are skyrocketing and lists lower taxes as a priority for families in the district.
taxes.short: Says property taxes skyrocketing; lists lower taxes as priority.

energy.summary: Makes environmental protection a central campaign theme, citing Pennsylvania's constitutional right to clean air and pure water and pointing to legacy mining damage, the Marjol Battery superfund site, and the Keystone Sanitary Landfill expansion. He says he will work to protect the district from an 'AI data center invasion' and businesses that are not environmentally friendly.
energy.short: Campaigns on environmental protection; cites landfill, superfund, data centers.
